capabilities: Open, edit, and save .csv files in a grid
Apply typed fields such as dates, checkboxes, selects, and links
Filter, group, sort, and conditionally fill rows and columns
Preview and visually edit .html files with a source mode
Show local image previews and vault internal-link indexes
disambiguation: Not a Markdown table or layout plugin; it edits CSV files and previews HTML files.
extras: Interface is currently in Simplified Chinese only. HTML previews run the page's own scripts in an isolated sandbox, and the README advises opening untrusted HTML in source mode first.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit CSV files as a table, and HTML files can only be read as plain text.
summary: CSV and HTML editor that opens, edits, and saves files in a grid with typed fields, filters, grouping, and sorting.
